what: parsnip Engines and Wrappers for Ordinal Classification Models
title: parsnip Engines and Wrappers for Ordinal Classification Models
text: ordered parsnip extension enable additional classification models ordinal outcomes (e.g., “low”, “medium”, “high”). several model/engine combinations parsnip package can used, package adds: cumulative link (cumulative logit) ordinal regression via MASS::polr() cumulative link ordinal regression via ordinal::clm() (Christensen, 2023) generalized linear generalized additive ordinal regression models cumulative link, adjacent categories, continuation ratio, stopping ratio families via VGAM::vglm() VGAM::vgam() (Yee, 2015) regularized elastic net ordinal regression models cumulative link, adjacent categories, continuation ratio, stopping ratio families via ordinalNet::ordinalNet() (Wurm, Hanlon, Rathouz, 2021) regularized cumulative probability ordinal regression models via rms::lrm() rms::orm() (Harrell, 2015) regularized elastic net continuation ratio ordinal regression via glmnetcr::glmnetcr() (Archer Williams, 2012) ordinal classification trees via rpartScore::rpartScore() (Galimberti, Soffritti, Di Maso, 2012) latent variable ordinal forests via ordinalForest::ordfor() (Hornung, 2020) conditional probability ordered forests via orf::orf() (Lechner Okasa, 2025) features tidymodels packages useful ordinal outcomes: partykit engines parsnip::decision_tree() parsnip::rand_forest(), provided bonsai, use ordinal nature ordered factors train model, yielding different fits unordered factors. yardstick package yardstick::kap() weighted unweighted Kappa statistics (former interest). Also, yardstick::classification_cost() can utilize complex cost structures uses class probabilities estimation.
